description: Defines the ldpc_encoder_metrics_aggregator class, which aggregates and reports metrics related to LDPC encoder performance, including codeblock counts, sizes, latencies, and processing rates.

classes.name: ldpc_encoder_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: A class that aggregates metrics for LDPC encoder performance, providing statistical data such as counts, latencies, and processing rates.

methods.name: get_nof_processed_cb
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed codeblocks.

methods.name: get_avg_cb_size
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average size of codeblocks in bits.

methods.name: get_avg_cb_latency_us
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average codeblock latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_min_cb_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the minimum codeblock latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_max_cb_latency_us
methods.description: Returns the maximum codeblock latency in microseconds.

methods.name: get_encode_rate_Mbps
methods.description: Calculates and returns the encoding rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_total_time
methods.description: Returns the total encoding time as a duration.

methods.name: get_cpu_usage_us
methods.description: Returns the CPU usage in microseconds.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all internal counters and metrics.
